## Starting point and request

New product, existing feature, bug, or migration. Use shareable material.

## Available evidence

Product decisions, repository context, constraints, and permitted actions.

## Observed problem

What decision or handoff is missing? What is the consequence?

## Expected observable outcome

Describe useful behavior, not required wording.

## Evaluation evidence

Desk review or actual agent execution? Include revision, runtime/model where relevant, and unavailable checks.
